entries.back_en: A thousand titans were defeated before Beigon selected new protectors to test potential Einherjars. I keep wondering how many dragons will have to perish before the Guardian frees them from this macabre fate. I understand his motives are pure, but I only see cruelty in using the lives of these noble creatures as a final test. I am aware that the protector creature's purpose is to repel travellers, but it is quite clear that whoever comes this far will hardly give up in a hurry. Tomorrow I shall set out on a long journey in search of creatures more deserving of serving in this manner. Such is my pact with Beigon. They shall be strong and terrifying, as is his wish, but also contemptible enough that their lives will not be worth lamenting. -The Beast Tamer-
entries.note: Accurate translation preserving meaning, tone, and voice.
